verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a monitoring SaaS, its CLI or its self-hosted distribution, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Server-side data scrubbing and self-hosting are related privacy features, not an opt-out of Sentry's own usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
